connector.name: Agent402.Tools - pay-per-call web tools
connector.registryDescription: 500+ pay-per-call tools + skill packs. USDC + USDG on 12 chains, or free via proof-of-work.
connector.summary: Hosted at agent402.tools over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package agent402-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the mikeypetrillo account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: AGENT_KEY
env.description: Hex private key of a wallet funded with USDC on Base (or Solana/Polygon/Arbitrum/Monad/Stellar/Algorand). Unset = proof-of-work mode (free pure-CPU tools).

env.name: AGENT402_BUDGET
env.description: Optional hard cap on total USDC spent per session (e.g. 1.00). Refused before any payment is signed.

env.name: AGENT402_MAX_PER_CALL
env.description: Optional max USD price for any single call (e.g. 0.01).
